A vulnerability in Fastjson prior to version 1.2.25, as utilized in Pippo 1.11.0, allows attackers to execute arbitrary code through specially crafted JSON requests. This occurs due to improper handling of data within the parseObject method, particularly when malformed rmi:// URIs are provided in the dataSourceName field of an HTTP POST request to the /json endpoint. Exploiting this flaw could lead to severe security implications, enabling remote attackers to execute unauthorized commands on the server.
